investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) This document applies to offences committed before the 28th June 2022 due to changes made by section 86 of the Police, Crime, Sentencing and Courts Act 2022, which increased the penalty on indictment from 14 years imprisonment to life imprisonment. For the offence applying from the 28th June 2022, see H100713.
(ii) See section 2a of the Road Traffic Act 1988 for the meaning of dangerous driving.
(iii) See section 13a of the Road Traffic Act 1988 for disapplication of section 1 for authorised motoring events.
(iv) See section 24 of the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988 for alternative verdicts.
(v) The penalty on indictment for this offence was raised by section 285(3) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003 from ten to fourteen years with effect from 27/02/04.
(vi) When investigating offences of causing death/serious injury by careless/dangerous driving, including (if applicable) under influence of drink/drugs, then before preparing charges consideration must be given to the CPS charging standards/guidelines for these offences.
